items.sm: Asks the Administration to proceed with Option 2 from the City's feasibility report: restore the Paul Clock Bell Tower and then transfer its ownership to the City.

items.t: Presentation on the rezoning of property at Madison Road in Madisonville
items.sm: Presents the rezoning of property at 5705 and 5711 Madison Road in Madisonville to Planned Development District No. 107.

items.t: Rezone 5707 and 5711 Madison Road for Veterans Village
items.sm: Rezones 5707 and 5711 Madison Road in Madisonville to Planned Development District No. 107, "Veterans Village."

items.t: Presentation on the proposed Clifton Neighborhood Plan
items.sm: Presents the proposed Clifton Neighborhood Plan for consideration and feedback.

items.t: Approve the Clifton Neighborhood Plan
items.sm: Approves the Clifton Neighborhood Plan as the planning guide for the Clifton neighborhood.

items.t: Presentation on the Revive + Thrive home repair loan program
items.sm: Presents the City's Revive + Thrive home repair loan program.

items.t: 5051 Estecreek Road property tax exemption
items.sm: Exempts improvements at 5051 Estecreek Road in Winton Hills from property tax for 30 years under the development agreement with OH Cincinnati Estecreek, LLC for a cold storage facility.

items.t: Fund pedestrian safety improvements in Pleasant Ridge
items.sm: Creates a capital project and moves $1 million from the Pleasant Ridge TIF fund for pedestrian safety and traffic calming along Montgomery Road, Losantiville Avenue, Ridge Avenue and nearby streets.

items.t: Approve a job creation tax credit for AMEND Consulting
items.sm: Approves a tax credit equal to 45 percent of new City income tax revenue for AMEND Consulting, which will create at least 80 jobs at 312 Plum Street.
